items.name: Fjord
items.pick: Cool blues that stay easy on the eyes all day.

items.name: Lagoon
items.pick: Bright teal for light mode, deep sea for night.

items.name: Moss
items.pick: Soft greens with gentle contrast, made for long reading.

items.name: Article outline
items.description: Outline a blog post, article or talk with a working title, the main argument, sections with key points and sources to find.
examples: Outline a blog post on why small teams should write things down
Turn my talk notes into a 20-minute outline with sections
Give me three working titles and an outline for an article on remote onboarding

items.name: Budget review
items.description: Review income and spending from a statement or spreadsheet, group it into categories and point out where money could be saved.
examples: Review my spending from this bank statement and find savings
Group last month's transactions into categories with totals
Where did most of my money go this quarter?

items.name: Bug report
items.description: Turn a vague problem description into a clear bug report with steps to reproduce, expected and actual behaviour, and environment.
examples: Turn this into a bug report: the app crashes when I upload a photo
Write steps to reproduce from this support message
Make this vague complaint into a ticket with expected and actual behaviour

items.name: Build dashboard
items.description: Build an interactive HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables. Use when creating an executive overview with KPI cards, turning query results into a shareable self-contained report, building a team monitoring snapshot, or needing multiple charts with filters in one browser-openable file.
examples: Build a dashboard from this sales CSV with a chart per region
Make an executive overview with KPI cards from these numbers
Turn this query result into a page with filters and a table

items.name: Calendar invite
items.description: Use when the person wants something added to their calendar from text, an email, a ticket or an itinerary, as an .ics file that opens in any calendar app.
examples: Add my flight and hotel to my calendar
Make a calendar invite from this email
Turn this class schedule into calendar events

reads: text, emails and tickets you share

items.name: Chart from data
items.description: Turn a table or CSV into a clear chart, choosing the right chart type and writing a one-line takeaway.
examples: Chart monthly revenue from this table
Which chart fits this survey data? Make it
Turn this CSV into a chart with a one-line takeaway

items.name: Code review
items.description: Review a code change for bugs first, then clarity and tests, and report findings ranked by severity with file and line.
examples: Review this pull request for bugs
Check this function for edge cases and missing tests
Rank the problems in this diff by severity

items.name: Compare options
items.description: Compare products, services or plans side by side on what matters to the person, and recommend one with the reasons.
examples: Compare these three phone plans for someone who travels a lot
Which project tool fits a team of five: Asana, Linear or Notion?
Put these two job offers side by side and recommend one

items.name: Competitive brief
items.description: Research competitors and write a positioning and messaging comparison with gaps, opportunities, and threats. Use for a sales battlecard, an unclaimed angle, or a competitor's move.
examples: Write a competitive brief on our three main rivals
Make a sales battlecard against this competitor
Find a positioning angle nobody in our market claims yet

items.name: Convert photos
items.description: Use when the person shares photos to convert, resize, compress, rotate or strip location from, including iPhone HEIC photos that won't open elsewhere.
examples: Turn these iPhone photos into JPGs
Make these photos small enough to email
Remove the location from these pictures before I post them

items.name: CSV cleanup
items.description: Clean a messy CSV file - trim spaces, normalize headers, drop empty and duplicate rows - and report what changed.
examples: Clean up this messy CSV and tell me what changed
Remove duplicate and empty rows from this export
Normalize the headers in this spreadsheet export

items.name: Decision memo
items.description: Write a one-page decision memo that lays out the options, trade-offs, a recommendation and what would change it.
examples: Write a decision memo on whether to hire or outsource support
Lay out the options and trade-offs for moving to a four-day week
Make a one-page memo recommending a CRM

items.name: Digest
items.description: Generate a daily or weekly digest of activity across all connected sources. Use when catching up after time away, starting the day and wanting a summary of mentions and action items, or reviewing a week's decisions and document updates grouped by project.
examples: Catch me up on what happened while I was away
Give me a digest of today across my connected apps
What changed this week in email, chat and tickets?

items.name: Word documents
items.description: Use when creating, reading, or editing a Word document (.docx or .dotx): reports, memos, letters, templates, tracked changes, comments, or find-and-replace. Not for PDFs or spreadsheets.
examples: Turn these notes into a formatted Word report
Find and replace the client name in this contract
Add comments to this document where the wording is unclear

items.name: Doublecheck
items.description: Three-layer verification pipeline for AI output. Extracts verifiable claims, finds supporting or contradicting sources via web search, runs adversarial review for hallucination patterns, and produces a structured verification report with source links for human review.
examples: Double-check this answer before I send it to a client
Verify the claims in this report against sources
Find what's wrong in this summary

items.name: Email drafter
items.description: Draft a clear email or reply from a few notes, matched to the reader and the tone the person wants.
examples: Draft a polite reply declining this meeting
Write an email asking for a deadline extension from these notes
Make this follow-up shorter and friendlier

items.name: Fact check
items.description: Check the claims in a text against reliable sources and mark each one as supported, wrong, misleading or unverified.
examples: Fact-check this article before I share it
Is this statistic about remote work true?
Mark each claim in this post as supported or not

items.name: Gift ideas
items.description: Suggest thoughtful gift ideas for a person and occasion within a budget, with where to get them.
examples: Gift ideas for my dad who loves gardening, under $50
What should I get a coworker who is leaving?
Birthday ideas for a 10-year-old into space

items.name: Inbox triage
items.description: Sort a pile of emails or messages into reply now, do later, read and ignore, with a one-line reason for each.
items.pick: Know what needs a reply today and what can wait.
examples: Sort these emails into reply now, later, read and ignore
Which of my messages today actually need an answer?
Triage this inbox export and draft the urgent replies

items.name: Invoice check
items.description: Check an invoice or bill against the quote, contract or order for wrong amounts, duplicates, missing details and due dates.
examples: Check this invoice against the quote
Is anything on this bill charged twice?
Compare this invoice to the contract and list the differences

items.name: Meal planner
items.description: Plan a week of meals around diet, budget and time, with simple recipes and one combined shopping list.
examples: Plan a week of vegetarian dinners under 30 minutes each
Make a meal plan for a family of four on a budget
Give me a shopping list for this week's meals

items.name: Meeting notes
items.description: Turn a meeting transcript or rough notes into a short summary with decisions, action items and open questions.
items.pick: Turns any transcript into decisions and action items in seconds.
examples: Turn this transcript into notes with decisions and action items
Summarize this call and list who does what by when
What questions were left open in this meeting?

items.name: Meeting prep
items.description: Prepare for a meeting with a short brief on the people, the goal, open items from last time and questions to ask.
examples: Prepare me for my call with Acme tomorrow
Brief me on the people in this meeting
What should I ask in my one-on-one this week?

items.name: PDF
items.description: Use when the person wants anything done with a PDF: read or extract text and tables, merge, split, rotate, watermark, create, fill a form, encrypt, pull images out, or OCR a scan.
examples: Pull the tables out of this PDF into a spreadsheet
Merge these three PDFs and add page numbers
Fill in this PDF form with my details

items.name: PowerPoint decks
items.description: Use whenever a .pptx or .potx file is involved: create or edit a slide deck, read text out of one, combine or split slides, or work with notes and comments.
examples: Make a 10-slide deck from this outline
Add speaker notes to every slide in this presentation
Pull all the text out of this deck

items.name: Proofread
items.description: Proofread a text for spelling, grammar, punctuation and clarity, keeping the author's voice, and list what changed.
examples: Proofread this cover letter
Fix the grammar in this post without changing my voice
Check this report for typos and list what you changed

items.name: Research brief
items.description: Research a question on the web and write a sourced brief with the answer first, key facts, disagreements and links.
items.pick: Answer first, sources after: research you can actually check.
examples: Research whether heat pumps work in cold climates
Write a sourced brief on the four-day work week
What do studies say about standing desks? Answer first, then sources

items.name: Rewrite tone
items.description: Rewrite a text in a different tone or for a different reader, such as friendlier, more formal, shorter or simpler.
examples: Make this message friendlier
Rewrite this for a ten-year-old
Turn this rant into a calm, professional email

items.name: Scan to PDF
items.description: Use when the person shares phone photos or scans of paper (receipts, letters, forms, book pages) and wants a clean, searchable PDF or the text from them.
examples: Turn these photos of my lease into one searchable PDF
Read the total and date off this receipt
Make a PDF of these pages and get the text out

items.name: Shrink a file
items.description: Use when a file is too big to send or upload (a PDF, photo, video, slide deck or folder) and the person needs it smaller, often under a size limit.
examples: Make this PDF small enough to email
Get this video under 25 MB
Compress this slide deck

items.name: Social post
items.description: Turn an announcement, article or idea into short social posts sized for each network, with a few variations to choose from.
examples: Turn this announcement into posts for LinkedIn and X
Write three versions of a post about our launch
Make a short thread from this blog post

items.name: Spreadsheet formulas
items.description: Write, explain or fix spreadsheet formulas for Excel or Google Sheets from a plain-language description of what is needed.
examples: Write a formula that sums sales by month
Why does this VLOOKUP return #N/A?
Explain this nested IF formula in plain words

items.name: SQL helper
items.description: Write, explain or speed up a SQL query from a plain-language question and the table structure.
examples: Write a query for the top 10 customers by revenue last year
Why is this query slow?
Explain what this SQL does

items.name: Summarize document
items.description: Summarize a long document, report or contract into the key points, numbers, obligations and anything that needs attention.
examples: Summarize this contract and list my obligations
Give me the key numbers from this annual report
What in this policy needs my attention?

items.name: Systematic debugging
items.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
examples: My tests pass locally but fail in CI. Help me find out why
This function returns the wrong total sometimes. Debug it step by step
Find the root cause of this crash before suggesting a fix

items.name: Teach
items.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
examples: Teach me how Git branches work
I want to learn SQL. Start me off
Help me understand compound interest with examples

items.name: Trip planner
items.description: Plan a trip day by day within a budget, with travel times, bookings to make and a packing list.
examples: Plan four days in Lisbon on a mid-range budget
Make a weekend itinerary in the mountains with travel times
What should I pack for a week in Japan in spring?

items.name: Web app testing
items.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
examples: Test the sign-up flow of my local app
Take a screenshot of my web app after logging in
Check my page's console for errors while clicking around

items.name: Weekly report
items.description: Write a concise weekly status report from tickets, chats and notes, grouped into done, in progress, blocked and next.
examples: Write my weekly status report from these notes
Group this week's tickets into done, in progress and blocked
Draft a short update for my manager

reads: tickets, chats and notes you share

items.name: Workout plan
items.description: Build a simple weekly workout plan around goals, fitness level, equipment and time, with how to progress.
examples: Make a three-day gym plan for a beginner
Plan home workouts with only dumbbells
How should I progress my running over eight weeks?

items.name: Write spec
items.description: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when turning a vague idea or user request into a structured document, scoping a feature with goals and non-goals, defining success metrics and acceptance criteria, or breaking a big ask into a phased spec.
examples: Write a spec for adding dark mode to our app
Turn this feature request into a PRD
Scope a first version of team invitations

items.name: Excel spreadsheets
items.description: Use when a spreadsheet is the main input or output: open, edit, or create .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv files, including formulas, charts, and cleaning messy tables.
examples: Clean this spreadsheet and add totals per column
Build a budget workbook with formulas and a chart
Convert this CSV into a formatted Excel file
